Vulnerabilities.Title: zlib: integer overflow in zipOpenNewFileInZip4_64 (MiniZip)
Vulnerabilities.Description: MiniZip in zlib has an integer overflow and resultant heap-based buffer overflow. Debian marks this as a minor issue not fixed in base packages.
